newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Mar qtr Capital Goods Price Index down 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ Mar qtr Capital Goods Price Index down 0.5 pct.

text.p: New Zealand's Capital Goods Price Index fell 0.5 percent in the March quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
The result follows falls of 0.1 percent in the December quarter and 0.2 percent in the September quarter.
The price index for construction of residential buildings fell 0.8 percent in the March quarter.
SNZ said the non-residential buildings price index rose 0.3 percent in the quarter, and is now 0.5 percent higher than in the March 1996 quarter.
The price index for transport equipment fell 1.2 percent, the largest quarterly decrease since September 1990. The price index for transport equipment has not risen since December 1994.

The quarterly movements in the price indexes for the six groups were: transport equipment, down 1.2 percent; residential buildings, down 0.8 percent; plant machinery and equipment, down 0.8 percent; other construction, down 0.4 percent, land improvements, up 0.3 percent; non-residential buildings, up 0.3 percent.
